title: Omega 3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid Supplements (PUFAs) and Microvolt T Wave Alternans (TWA) in Patients With Ventricular Arrhythmia

sections.abstract: This is a hypothesis testing study, the hypothesis being that dietary supplements of n-PUFAs concentrates are anti-arrhythmic in ventricular arrhythmic substrates. Study Aims: To investigate whether dietary supplements of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid concentrates (2g PUFAs/day, Omacor) reduces MTWA (a surrogate endpoint for ventricular arrhythmia substrate) in patients with ICDs for malignant ventricular arrhythmias.
